name: Dun Algaz
summary: Dragonmaw orcs have laid siege to Dun Algaz, cutting easy passage between Ironforge’s lands and Menethil Harbor. The fortified pass and its tunnels link Loch Modan with the Wetlands.

sections.title: A Chokepoint Between Realms
sections.body: Dun Algaz cuts through the jagged peaks between Loch Modan and the Wetlands. The pass predates the War of the Three Hammers. After the Wildhammer clan was driven from Ironforge, its people used this route to migrate north. Stone tunnels, bastions, and watchposts guard the way. Whoever holds Dun Algaz controls the only overland road from the dwarven heartlands to Menethil Harbor on the western sea.

sections.title: The Dragonmaw Resurgence
sections.body: During the Second War, the Old Horde retreated to Dun Algaz after its defeat at Dun Modr. The pass became its final southern bulwark against Sir Anduin Lothar’s forces. The Alliance reclaimed it for a time, but Dragonmaw orcs have overrun the stronghold again. Dwarven Mountaineers have fallen back to the upper tunnels, leaving the mountain corridor a deadly gauntlet for travelers.

faq.q: Why is Dun Algaz so dangerous right now?
aliases: why are there orcs in dun algaz
faq.answer: Dragonmaw orcs have descended from the surrounding mountains and seized the lower pass and stronghold. Dwarven Mountaineers have been pushed back to the upper pass near Algaz Station, leaving the main road swarming with hostile orcs who ambush travelers between Loch Modan and the Wetlands.

faq.q: Why is this pass so important to the dwarves?
aliases: why does ironforge need dun algaz
faq.answer: Dun Algaz is the main overland route from Ironforge and Loch Modan to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Menethil Harbor is Khaz Modan’s main shipping gateway to the rest of the Alliance territories, making the pass vital for supplies, troops, and trade.

faq.q: Did Dun Algaz play a role in the Second War?
faq.answer: Yes. After their defeat at Dun Modr, the Orcish Horde fell back across the Thandol Valley to make Dun Algaz a defensive stronghold. Sir Anduin Lothar ordered an assault to drive them from Khaz Modan, but the Alliance could not fully root out the Horde, leaving Dun Algaz among its final strongholds in the region.

faq.q: What is the history between Dun Algaz and the Wildhammer dwarves?
aliases: war of the three hammers pass
faq.answer: Long before the Second War, the Wildhammer dwarves were driven from Ironforge during the ancient War of the Three Hammers. They traveled through Dun Algaz to migrate north into the Wetlands and eventually settle in Grim Batol.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know Dun Algaz as an ancestral highway cut through the spine of Khaz Modan. Dragonmaw orcs now occupy its dwarven bastions and threaten the supply lines to Menethil Harbor, an ongoing insult and security crisis.
For the Alliance, Dun Algaz is a critical route for supplies and troops, joining Menethil Harbor with Loch Modan and Ironforge.
